title: What can the industry learn from the Sheeran/Macklemore fallout?
summary: The fallout around Macklemore’s removal from Ed Sheeran’s US stadium tour has prompted complex questions around artistic freedom and the power large venues can wield over tours, with experts warning that artists may need to start building speech protection into their contracts. IQ has spoken to a range of industry experts to assess what issues have been raised for the industry. title: Oasis expands Live ’27 dates, rearranges Paris show
summary: Due to demand, Oasis have added an extra four shows to their Live ’27 tour, bringing the total up to 42 dates, in addition to rescheduling a date in Paris due to planned transport works. title: Lila Live Academy looks to boost backstage careers for South Asian talent
summary: Less than a week remains for applications to Live Academy, a new UK-based new nationwide support scheme designed to build routes into live music production for South Asian talent, launched this month by non-profit Lila. Funded by Arts Council England’s Supporting Grassroots Music fund, Live Academy aims to select twelve participants aged 18–30 to complete an eight‑week evening production course this autumn, taught by working industry professionals. The application window closes on 28 September. title: A 26,000-cap bet on Guadalajara: OCESA opens Coliseo GNP Seguros
summary: Michael Bublé opened Coliseo GNP Seguros on Tuesday in front of 19,400 people, bringing into service a 55-year-old university football ground in Guadalajara that OCESA has spent the past year converting into a music venue. For Memo Parra, OCESA’s international events director, the most valuable thing about it is not how many people it holds. It is that nobody else controls the calendar. summary: The world’s largest gathering of live music professionals, the International Live Music Conference (ILMC), has unveiled its theme of ‘Around the World in 8o Hours’ for its 39th edition, ahead of its return to London from 23-26 February 2027. title: GEI to mark new chapter with venue move for 19th edition
summary: Organisers of the Green Events & Innovations Conference (GEI) have announced the sustainability conference’s next chapter, revealing a move to London’s The O2 for its 19th edition next year. title: Contra Promotion launches gender-marginalised artist program
summary: German promoter Contra has launched a call for applications from early career female and gender-marginalised artists, in an effort to address gender balance across the live sector. Named ‘Claim Your Stage’, the scheme is searching for artists from FLINTA* communities, a German abbreviation referring to women, as well as lesbian, intersex, non-binary, transgender, and agender individuals. Led by Contra, the scheme is in co-operation with Summer Breeze Festival, Deichbrand, and Rock for People. summary: Calvin Harris has earned a Guinness World Record after drawing an estimated 1.6 million fans to a free performance in Brazil, setting a new bar for the largest attendance for a DJ set by a single artist.
